name: Inmuebles24 CDMX - Real Estate Scraper & Notifier

nodes.name: Schedule: 3x Daily
nodes.notes: Runs at 8AM, 2PM, and 8PM daily (server timezone). Adjust cron expression for your timezone. For Mexico City (UTC-6), if server is UTC, use: 0 14,20,2 * * *

nodes.name: Setup: Generate Run Config
nodes.notes: Creates a unique run ID and generates items for each page to scrape. Adjust the pages array to scrape more or fewer pages.

nodes.name: Firecrawl: Scrape Page
nodes.notes: Calls Firecrawl API to scrape each page. Authentication: Create an HTTP Header Auth credential with Name='Authorization' and Value='Bearer YOUR_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY'. The waitFor parameter gives JS time to render listings.

nodes.name: Parse: Extract Listings from Markdown
nodes.notes: Parses the Firecrawl markdown output to extract structured listing data. Uses multiple regex strategies to handle varying page structures. Generates a unique hash for each listing for deduplication.

nodes.name: Supabase: Get Existing Listings
nodes.notes: Fetches all active listing hashes from Supabase. Used to compare against newly scraped listings to find only NEW ones. Configure Supabase credentials with your project URL and service_role key.

nodes.name: Compare: Find New Listings
nodes.notes: Compares freshly scraped listings against existing Supabase records. Uses Set for O(1) hash lookup. Outputs only NEW listings that haven't been seen before.

nodes.name: IF: New Listings Found?
nodes.notes: Branches the workflow: YES if new listings were found, NO if all are duplicates.

nodes.name: Prepare: Split Listings for Insert
nodes.notes: Transforms the array of new listings into individual n8n items, each ready to be inserted into Supabase.

nodes.name: Supabase: Insert New Listings
nodes.notes: Inserts each new listing as a row in the Supabase 'listings' table. Runs once per new listing item.

nodes.name: Format: Notification Message
nodes.notes: Creates formatted notification messages for Telegram (HTML) and Email (plain text). Shows up to 10 listings in Telegram, 20 in email. Includes property details, prices, locations, and direct links.

nodes.name: Telegram: Send Notification
nodes.notes: Sends the formatted notification to Telegram. Requires: 1) Create a bot via @BotFather, 2) Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID as n8n environment variables. Alternative: hardcode the values directly.

nodes.name: Webhook: Slack/Discord (Optional)
nodes.notes: Optional: Send notification to Slack or Discord webhook. Set WEBHOOK_URL as n8n environment variable or replace the URL directly. Can be disabled if not needed.

nodes.name: Supabase: Log Successful Run
nodes.notes: Logs the successful scrape run with statistics to the scrape_logs table.

nodes.name: Supabase: Log No-Change Run
nodes.notes: Logs runs where no new listings were found, keeping a complete audit trail.

nodes.name: NoOp: End (No New Listings)
nodes.notes: Workflow ends here when no new listings are found.
